name: intenttube
description: IntentTube is a web application designed to help users take control of their YouTube viewing habits by providing a focused environment for curated channels and playlists, free from distractions and recommendations.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
